title: Control undone by vast praise
subtitle: For the hand that keeps tightening around outcomes
description: Begin among the many voices singing divine power, gifts, beauty, and command. The path widens the mind until control looks too small for reality and action can become obedient rather than possessive.

heroSource.shortMeaning: The shabad opens a world where every power and gift belongs to the One being praised.
heroSource.lifeApplication: When the hand tightens around an outcome, name one gift or power that was never yours to own.

evidence.coreClaim: This journey places the controlling self inside a vast chorus of praise where mastery gives way to received power and gift.
evidence.turn: For control that needs to become obedient action
evidence.practicalImplication: Move through the five steps by releasing one managed outcome, then act from the gift you have been given rather than the power you are trying to seize.
